theme: A clear afternoon, with holiday bookings past their dates.
greeting: A light day, Dan — two calls around midday, then the afternoon opens right up. The real pull today is the holiday travel you keep circling: a couple of your own booking windows have slipped past.

needsAttention.title: Reply to the CIFIC recruiter
needsAttention.detail: The recruiter for the VP, Government Relations & Regulatory Affairs role at CIFIC followed up after your virtual interview yesterday and it's still unanswered — in a live search, a same-day reply is worth it.

needsAttention.title: December trip is past its book-by date
needsAttention.detail: Your own Oct 15 book-by date for the three-week December break with all four girls passed yesterday. The open decision is domestic vs. international — pick one and lock it, since passports won't be in hand when you book.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV still unbooked
needsAttention.detail: The p1 'book this week' task — a refundable full-size SUV out of Portland for Christmas week — has been overdue since mid-September. Holiday inventory out of PWM is the thing that genuinely sells out.

flagged.title: Morgan Stanley savings account
flagged.detail: A repeated 'fund your new Signature Savings account' notice, flagged as a final reminder — worth a glance if that account is real to you.
